entries.description: Women's center offering intensive residential courses and retreats from spring to fall; 10 acres adjoining several hundred wild acres, with buildings, camping space, woods and a bio-dynamic garden; welcomes new members/residents, workshop participants and guides, interns/apprentices, staff, private retreatants and artists in residence, and all wild women.
entries.raw_text: HARDSCRABBLE HILL CENTER Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472 (207)469-7112. From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. We welcome: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence. We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey, creating new names as we go. We have: 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, women living and workin' the land.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space because it is an educational center whose main purpose is courses and retreats (named in codebook). Land: street/road address 'Box 130-Castine Rd' treated as the land. Acreage: 10 acres; adjoining wild land not counted. Accepted groups: 'We welcome all wild women' read as Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women (pre-1986, 'women' welcome). Focuses: Workshops/education from 'courses', 'internships-apprentices'; Farming/self-sufficiency from 'bio-dynamic garden' and 'workin' the land' (weak). Residents blank: no count given.

entries.description: Small family of 2 lesbians and 2 girl children on 30 acres with cleared trails, surrounded by undeveloped land; no housing for visitors but campers welcome; camping near road available for differently abled lesbians; no drugs; welcomes girl children (boys by invitation only), non-lesbian women and dogs.
entries.raw_text: LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172. We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. We welcome: girl children (boys by invitation only!), nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 30 acres of land, housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods, women living and workin' on the land.
entries.notes: Contact name from the listing heading, which has no community name (name used as community_name). Type: Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule: 2 lesbians, no recruiting of members. Land: rural route address is the land. Acreage 30; surrounding 100's of acres not counted. Residents 4: 2 lesbians + 2 girl children, 'women living and workin' on the land'. Accepted groups: lesbians (campers/visitors), 'girl children', 'nonlesbian women'; 'boys by invitation only' not coded. Focus Recovery/substance-free: 'We do not smoke, drink, use drugs'. 'Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians' noted, not coded as Disabled women focus.

entries.description: Additional information to an earlier listing: offers retreat and healing space mostly as primitive camping for $2 to $5 a day; 143 mostly uphill acres, poor accessibility, probable visitor kitchen, sauna in progress, two ponds for swimming; work welcomed; chemicals discouraged.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805. This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress and both ponds are fine for swimming. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.
entries.notes: Type: Retreat/Gathering Space from 'retreat and healing space'. Land: rural route address is the land. Acreage 143 from '(143 acres almost all uphill.)'. 'Chemicals are discouraged' not coded as Environmentalism (not an explicit principle of the place). No welcomed groups named. Additional info to listing in VI,2.

entries.description: One woman homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows, chickens, bees, fruit trees and garden; not a separatist; visits limited to 2-3 days with work exchange; no drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns; non-lesbian women welcome; has house, barn, farmland, pasture.
entries.raw_text: ONEIDA FARM RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019 (717)432-2157. (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. Non-lesbian women welcome. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit. I have a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land, one woman ('I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter'). Residents 1: single person speaking in first person. Accepted groups: 'Non-lesbian women welcome'; Lesbian women assumed as the directory is for lesbians. Focus Farming from homesteader/farmer with livestock and garden; Recovery/substance-free from 'No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns'. Separatism rejected ('I am not a separatist'), not coded. Land city Dillsburg from mailing address.

entries.description: New women's community/retreat center 35 miles north of Baltimore with 4 lesbians on 35 acres of woods, meadow and stream held in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, camping and indoor space; developing retreat center for up to 50 as a business; welcomes visitors, new members, all women and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE WOMENS COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-1070. We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. We welcome: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!
entries.notes: Type: Land Trust because the land is 'in a land trust' (overrides community/retreat). Land: street address is the land. Residents 4: '4 lesbians' on the land, 'support the place and members' implies they live there; moderate inference. Accepted groups: 'all women of all colours and persuasions' = Lesbian + Non-lesbian women; 'girl and boy children'. Focuses: Workshops/education from developing retreat center (weak); Farming from 'organic gardens, bees'; Environmentalism from 'wood and solar heat' (explicit practice). Woman-owned businesses mentioned but not land.

entries.community_name: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET
entries.land_location_as_stated: Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.
entries.description: Two lesbians own 20 acres with a passive solar shell built this summer; they work away from the land; goal of small-scale farming; musicians who welcome non-competitive musicians and singers; welcome non-lesbian women, children, males and small dogs; no drugs, tobacco or heavy drinkers.
entries.raw_text: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447 (304)258-5079. (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which we built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. We welcome: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please). Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs), wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.
entries.notes: Group has no name; used the printed heading. Contact c/o Nan and Ruth. PO box so land street/zip blank; land city Unger from '(Between ... )' and mailing. Type: Private/Individual Land by two-woman rule ('2 lesbians'), no recruiting of members. Accepted groups: 'non-lesbian wimmin', 'girl & boy children', 'males' = Gay men + Non-gay men. Residents blank: '2 lesbians' ... 'wimmin living (full time)' suggests 2, but they 'work away from the land'; left blank to be cautious. Focuses: Recovery/substance-free from 'No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers'; Archives/cultural work from 'We are musicians'; Farming from small-scale farming goal. Passive solar noted, not coded as an explicit principle.

entries.description: 3-5 women on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio with a house, a barn and another house under construction, animals, gardens, woods, pond; welcomes women and children for up to a week for help with food and work exchange.
entries.raw_text: MOON RIDGE Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735. We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland, wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house remodeling - house building - daily survival chores).
entries.notes: Type: Intentional Community/Cooperative, 3-5 women living on the land. Residents: range 3-5, smaller number 3 stored. Accepted groups: 'wimmin and children' = Lesbian + Non-lesbian women (pre-1986) and Girl + Boy children. Focus Farming from goats, gardens, farmland and 'daily survival chores' (weak). Land: rural route address is the land.

entries.description: One lesbian on 3+ acres in northern Minnesota offering country living with privacy for womyn; ten miles from town with access to a small lake; welcomes womyn of all ages and dogs if restrained; visits require work exchange and/or cash.

Company of womyn of all ages welcomed. Dogs if restrained. Visits require work exchange and/or cash. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 3+ acres, house/permanent structures, electricity, well, camping space, organic garden, sauna, 2 dogs, cat, woods.
entries.notes: Type: Private/Individual Land, one woman ('I am/have: 1 lesbian'). Acreage '3+' stored as 3. Residents 1 from 'I am/have: 1 lesbian' with a house; first-person statement. Accepted groups: 'womyn of all ages' = Lesbian + Non-lesbian women (pre-1986). Organic garden is only a checklist item; no focus coded. Lake is 'access to', not owned.
